title: 🎓 Multiple Education Jobs Now Open Across Ventura County
text:
9 hours ago Ventura County’s education scene is buzzing with new opportunities — from college teaching roles to a high-level coaching position in professional sports. Here are a few standout openings worth checking out:
Head of Goalkeeping Employer: Angel City Football Club
Location: Thousand Oaks, CA
Type: Full-time
Salary: $140,000–$150,000/year
Join a world-class women’s soccer organization that’s shaping the future of the sport. This role works closely with the Head Coach to train and develop goalkeepers, design set-piece strategies, and lead performance analysis. Comes with full medical coverage, 401K, and game-day perks.
Instructor in Nursing Science/Clinical Practice (Part-Time Pool) Employer: Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD)
Location: Districtwide (Oxnard, Moorpark, and Ventura Colleges)
Type: Part-time
Salary: $2,408–$3,108 per semester per 10% load
VCCCD is building a pool of part-time nursing science instructors for upcoming semesters. Ideal for experienced nurses who want to teach clinical practice and mentor the next generation of healthcare professionals.
Instructor in Nursing (Part-Time Pool) Employer: Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD)
Location: Districtwide (Oxnard, Moorpark, and Ventura Colleges)
Type: Part-time
Salary: $2,408–$3,108 per semester per 10% load
Another great teaching opportunity with VCCCD for those holding advanced nursing degrees. You’ll provide classroom and lab instruction, guide students through coursework, and help shape strong, compassionate nurses.
If you’re ready to share your skills and make a difference in Ventura County’s classrooms or on the field, now’s a great time to apply.
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
